The powerful adamantine dragons are one of several dragons known as skymetal dragons. The innate magic that flows through these dragons causes them to draw particular metals to their bodies like magnets or, in some cases, naturally grow these skymetals on their bodies. Adamantine dragons begin their lives with tough scales that are naturally replaced with thicker and even tougher adamantine plating as they grow older. Adamantine dragons are typically steadfast and loyal. Once they commit to a certain purpose, changing their minds is nigh impossible. **[Recall Knowledge - Dragon](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35)): DC 40 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 38 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 35 [Ancient Adamantine Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2934) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 109 **Perception** +30; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet, [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=82) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 120 feet **Languages** [Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=13), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Fey](/Languages.aspx?ID=119), [Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109), [Sakvroth](/Languages.aspx?ID=118) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +28, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +36, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +32, [Mining Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +30, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +29, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +31 **Str** +9 **Dex** +4 **Con** +8 **Int** +4 **Wis** +5 **Cha** +6 --- **AC** 41 **Fort** +32 **Ref** +26 **Will** +29 +2 status to all saves vs. [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676) **HP** 300 **Immunities** [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [petrified](/Conditions.aspx?ID=87), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696) **Resistances** physical 20 (except [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=374)) **Abandon Armor** Once the adamantine dragon is reduced to fewer than half their Hit Points, their resistance is reduced by 10 and they gain a +10 circumstance bonus to their Speeds.
**[Frightful Presence](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=64)** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) 90 feet, DC 37
**Resilient Form** **Trigger** The dragon is critically hit with a weapon or unarmed attack; **Effect** The dragon's tough scales ward off deadly attacks. The dragon attempts a DC 17 flat check. On a success, the triggering attack becomes a normal hit. --- **Speed** 40 feet, burrow 50 feet, fly 180 feet **Melee** jaws +36 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d12+18 piercing plus [Improved Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=27) **Melee** claw +36 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d8+18 slashing plus [Knockdown](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=46) **Melee** tail +34 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d10+18 bludgeoning **Ranged** rock +34 ([Brutal](/Traits.aspx?ID=249), [range increment 150 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 3d8+18 bludgeoning **Adamantine Body** The dragon's unarmed melee Strikes are [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=374). **Avalanche Breath** ([Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) The dragon belches a mass of boulders that deals 15d8 bludgeoning damage in a 40-foot cone (DC 40 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). They can't use Avalanche Breath again for 1d4 rounds. **Burrowing Pounce** **Requirements** The dragon is burrowed; **Effect** The dragon [Burrows](/Actions.aspx?ID=2310), then [Leaps](/Actions.aspx?ID=2298) out of the ground, landing at a point within 25 feet. The dragon makes a melee Strike against a creature within reach when they land. If the Strike is a critical hit, the target is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88). **Fast Swallow** **Trigger** The dragon [Grabs](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) a creature; **Effect** The dragon uses [Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77). **Draconic Frenzy** The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order. **Draconic Momentum** The dragon recharges their Avalanche Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike. **Rock Tunneler** The dragon can burrow through solid stone at a Speed of 20 feet. They can leave a tunnel if they desire, and they usually don't. **[Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77)** Large, 3d12+14 bludgeoning, Rupture 35 **[Throw Rock](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=80)**
